method: Original procedural pixel artwork; no extracted Tank Force sprites or generated photographs.
limits: Art direction inspired by Tank Force, not a port or exact asset reproduction. Unseen palettes retain native fallback.
enemy_classes: Basic: compact round turret, short exposed tracks
Fast: narrow tapered chassis, small turret, long tracks
Power: rear casemate, long gun and wide muzzle brake
Armor: broad square turret, thick side skirts, wide tracks

texture_audit.method: Every-frame tile/palette capture with sampled HD rendering. Disposable RAM counters accelerate score transitions; not a normal full playthrough.
